meta.name: develop-tdd
meta.description: When this skill is loaded, the developer follows the Red-Green-Refactor cycle. The orchestrator loads this skill when the user requests TDD.

copy.tagline: 按红绿重构循环编写测试驱动代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果采用TDD方式开发，需要遵循红绿重构循环。
copy.tagline_en: Write test-driven code following the Red-Green-Refactor cycle
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you practice TDD and need to follow the Red-Green-Refactor cycle.

howto.what: Claude 会按照红-绿-重构循环开发：先写测试（红），再写最少代码让测试通过（绿），最后优化代码（重构）。每次步骤后都会报告结果。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 使用测试驱动开发（TDD）时触发。

say.text: 用 TDD 写一个计算器加法函数。
say.note: Claude 会先写测试，再实现代码。

say.text: 用 TDD 实现用户登录功能。
say.note: Claude 会按红-绿-重构步骤进行。

howto.what_en: Claude follows the Red-Green-Refactor cycle: write failing tests first (Red), then minimal code to pass (Green), then refactor. Reports results after each step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to use Test-Driven Development (TDD).

say_en.text: Use TDD to write an addition function for a calculator.
say_en.note: Claude will write tests first, then implement.
